name: reseassistenten-chatgpt-plugin
description: Portable OpenAI Agent Plugin (plugin.json + mcp.json) that connects ChatGPT and Codex to the ReseAssistenten remote MCP server over OAuth.

scripts.pack: node scripts/validate.js && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && zip -j dist/reseassistenten-chatgpt-plugin.zip plugin.json mcp.json README.md
scripts.pack:win: node scripts/validate.js && powershell -NoProfile -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force dist | Out-Null; Compress-Archive -Force -Path plugin.json,mcp.json,README.md -DestinationPath dist/reseassistenten-chatgpt-plugin.zip"
